Kept in the hub, never taken into a run. Crafting, unsealing and selling use the bag and the stash together.

Feel-test prototype. Runs here are simulated: the run model uses each area's real roster (monster level, XP, adena), the stepped XP rates and the death rule (no XP loss below level 40, the L2 penalty from 40), with kill and death rates taken from the 20-minute headless test runs on the area pages. Stats come from the area pages at each level (M.Def is calculated). Class trials 1–3 and Areas 1–7 are playable. Level cap 80. B/A drops can be worn (Character & Gear, or double-click in the run’s inventory) and are kept between runs. Progress is saved in this browser.
